title: Dutch governments builds alternative for Microsoft based on NixOS
summary: The Dutch government is developing a custom operating system based on NixOS as an alternative to Microsoft products, aiming to achieve technological sovereignty and reduce dependency on proprietary software vendors.
problem_solved: Reduces Dutch government dependency on proprietary Microsoft software and enables full control over IT infrastructure through reproducible, declarative system configurations.
why_valuable: Demonstrates that governments can build viable sovereign IT infrastructure alternatives, setting a precedent for digital independence from major tech corporations.
